Grant PUD currently serves 8 data center operators in Grant County.
Grant PUD's total average system load in 2025 was approximately 757 average megawatts, meaning data centers represented about 37% of overall county load.
In 2025, Grant PUD's 8 data center operators accounted for approximately 280 average megawatts ( aMW ) of electrical load.
